description: This file defines the configuration class 'I18nPluginConfiguration' for the internationalization (i18n) plugin in the OrangeHRM system. It implements the 'PluginConfigurationInterface' and registers 'I18NService' and 'I18NHelper' services during initialization.

classes.name: I18nPluginConfiguration
classes.description: Configuration class for the i18n plugin, implementing service registration during initialization.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin by registering the I18N service and helper in the container.
